MAPPING.NAME: m_ORDERS_STG_TO_FACT_ORDERS
MAPPING.DESCRIPTION: Incremental upsert of order headers from RAW.ORDERS_STG into DW.FACT_ORDERS.

MAPPING_VARIABLE.NAME: $$LAST_EXTRACT_TS
MAPPING_VARIABLE.DESCRIPTION: Read from AUDIT.ETL_CONTROL.LAST_EXTRACT_TS (or OVERRIDE_START_TS when set) by the pre-session SQL.

TRANSFORMATION.NAME: SQ_ORDERS_STG
TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Applies the source filter and keeps only the latest row per ORDER_ID using QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ORDER_ID ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC) = 1.

TRANSFORMATION.NAME: LKP_DIM_CUSTOMER
TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Connected lookup on DW.DIM_CUSTOMER with condition CUSTOMER_ID = IN_CUSTOMER_ID AND IS_CURRENT = 'Y'. When no row matches (guest checkout or customer not yet loaded) CUSTOMER_SK defaults to -1, the seeded Unknown customer.

TRANSFORMATION.NAME: LKP_FACT_ORDERS_EXISTING
TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Looks up ORDER_SK in DW.FACT_ORDERS by ORDER_ID to decide insert versus update.

TRANSFORMATION.NAME: UPD_ORDERS
TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: IIF(ISNULL(LKP_ORDER_SK), DD_INSERT, DD_UPDATE). Rows whose SOURCE_UPDATED_AT is not newer than the existing row are rejected with DD_REJECT so replays never overwrite newer data.

FIELD_MAPPING.LOGIC: NEXTVAL on insert only; existing rows keep their key

SESSION.NAME: s_m_ORDERS_STG_TO_FACT_ORDERS
SESSION.PRE_SQL: Reads LAST_EXTRACT_TS, OVERRIDE_START_TS and LOOKBACK_MINUTES (120) from AUDIT.ETL_CONTROL for this job.
SESSION.POST_SQL: On success only: sets LAST_EXTRACT_TS to MAX(SOURCE_UPDATED_AT) loaded, clears OVERRIDE_START_TS and writes AUDIT.JOB_RUN_LOG.
SESSION.ON_FAILURE: Session fails the workflow; the watermark is not advanced.
